remarks: Located in the highly desirable Winnipauk Village community, this beautifully maintained end-unit townhouse offers bright, sun-filled living across three spacious levels. Enjoy a private deck overlooking open green space, a generous living room with a cozy wood-burning fireplace and sliders, and a dining area filled with natural light from oversized windows. Hardwood floors run throughout, and the eat-in kitchen features stainless steel appliances and ample space for casual dining. Both bedrooms offer en-suite baths and abundant closet space. The expansive lower level provides flexible space ideal for a family room, home office, or recreation area. Secure entry and a peaceful setting complete the package, all while being just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, train access, major highways, and an easy commute to NYC.
